notes: The supplied page is the Architecture - Professional Practice, AS degree page only. It mentions that a Certificate of Achievement exists but prints no requirements for it, so no blocks were recorded for the certificate. A reviewer should locate the certificate's own catalog page.

The A.S. section prints: Required Core 29 units (ARCH 100, 107, 108, 119, 121, 251, 252, 170, 149, 199), plus a minimum of 7 units from ARCH 125, 258, 171, 172, 299. Total Major Units: 36. The page also offers ECC GE 24 units or Cal-GETC 34 units, electives to reach a minimum of 60 units, and Minimum Degree Total: 60 units. None of these figures were recorded because they belong to the A.S., not the certificate.

Several A.S. codes appear to be renumbered versions of closed-list courses: ARCH 251/252 for ARCH 150A/150B, ARCH 258 for ARCH 158, and possibly ARCH 299 for ARCH 179. ARCH 107/108 may have replaced ARCH 104.
The career 'entry-level draftsperson' comes from the program description, which says it applies to students earning either a degree or the certificate. The page prints no program learning outcomes.
